validated_results.title: Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids: a modified approach for chemo-prevention of bladder cancer in a rat model and molecular studies of antineoplastic mechanisms.

validated_results.title: BRCA1 haploinsufficiency promotes chromosomal amplification under Fenton reaction-based carcinogenesis through ferroptosis-resistance.
validated_results.reason: Renal carcinogenesis was studied only in a rat Brca1 haploinsufficiency model with ferric nitrilotriacetate treatment and molecular analyses, providing no human exposure data.

validated_results.title: A prospective trial investigating the role of Serum 25-Hydroxyvitamin D in diagnosis and prognosis of bladder cancer.
validated_results.reason: Serum 25(OHD) was measured at the time of bladder cancer diagnosis in hematuria patients to assess diagnostic discrimination and recurrence prognosis, so it does not provide evidence on risk of developing incident bladder cancer.

validated_results.title: Transcriptional and metabolic remodeling in clear cell renal cell carcinoma caused by ATF4 activation and the integrated stress response (ISR).
validated_results.reason: Vitamin A deficiency effects were examined only in transgenic murine kidneys and human RCC cell lines with transcriptomic and metabolomic assays, with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Transcriptional and metabolic remodeling in clear cell renal cell carcinoma caused by ATF4 activation and the integrated stress response (ISR).
validated_results.reason: The study is a preclinical mouse-model and cell-line mechanistic investigation of ATF4 signaling, offering no human kidney cancer incidence estimate for vitamin A.

validated_results.title: Transcriptional and metabolic remodeling in clear cell renal cell carcinoma caused by ATF4 activation and the integrated stress response (ISR).
validated_results.reason: Evidence derives from TRACK transgenic mice, wild-type kidneys, and RCC4 cell lines rather than any human population exposed to vitamin A.

validated_results.title: Apigenin in cancer prevention and therapy: A systematic review and meta-analysis of animal models.
validated_results.reason: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of animal-model studies of apigenin, providing neither original nor human incidence data for renal cell carcinoma.
